findings.finding: The worked non-reflexive one-world model assigns p true, then describes making Box A implies A true by choosing p suitably without qualifying A. That assignment establishes the displayed instance only when A is p (or a suitable formula involving p); it does not make every arbitrary A work, such as a falsity constant in the empty-accessibility frame.
findings.controlling_evidence: The immediately preceding example is Box p implies p. The later frame-validity definition quantifies over all valuations and thereby blocks extrapolation from one assignment.
findings.required_translation_handling: Explicitly restrict this example to A=p and disclose the restriction adjacent to the sentence; retain the frozen English source and the later all-valuations argument.
